resources.string: Your WhatsApp stickers in a keyboard, ready for Instagram.
Turn on \"StickerBridge\" in the system keyboard list. It has no letter keys and never reads what you type.
✓ StickerBridge is enabled and currently selected
In the folder picker, open \"WhatsApp Stickers\" and tap \"Use this folder\". StickerBridge only gets read access to this one folder.
This doesn\'t look like a WhatsApp stickers folder.

GIF size test: send an animated sticker from the keyboard first
GIF size test: %1$s. Open the keyboard → Debug tab.
Play animated stickers in the keyboard (Android 9+). Turn off to save battery.
The folder holds stickers that appeared in your chats, not your WhatsApp favorites. Order is \"recently seen\" (file time), not WhatsApp\'s own order. Everything stays on this phone.
Connect your WhatsApp stickers folder to see stickers here.

Long-press a sticker to add it to favorites

• Navigation-bar keyboard button: on Samsung, turn on \"Keyboard button on navigation bar\" (Settings → General management → Keyboard list and default). While typing, tap the small keyboard icon at the bottom right and pick StickerBridge.
• Quick Settings tile: swipe down twice, tap ✎ / \"Edit\", drag the \"StickerBridge\" tile into your tiles. While typing, swipe down and tap it to choose a keyboard.
• App shortcut: long-press the StickerBridge app icon and tap \"Switch to sticker keyboard\" (you can drag it to your home screen).
In the sticker keyboard, \"◀ Keyboard\" takes you back to your normal keyboard.
